Lapa Lange Game Lodge
An Oasis In The Heart Of Southern Namibia
Lapa Lange Game Lodge is surrounded by the majestic beauty of Southern Namibia, a diverse and stark landscape, rich in plant, animal and bird life. There are over thirty different species of game to be found on our semi-desert savannah.

Accommodation
This oasis surprises you from the minute you arrive.
With lush green rolling lawns and water features on the edge of the Kalahari. Expect friendly staff, contempory decoration in air-conditioned thatched accommodation, ice cold beers and cocktails. An evening game drive with sundowners, followed by a traditional barbeque while being entertained by the dancing and singing of local San people under a starry Namibian sky is a must do for guests at Lapa Lange.

ABOUT LAPA LANGE
Your Namibian Safari starts here.
Lapa Lange Game Lodge is located in South Central Namibia, on the edge of the Kalahari.
The lodge accommodates 68 guests in self-catering units and en-suite rooms on a dinner, bed and breakfast basis.
There are also camping facilities on a beautiful green lawn area. Our restaurant offers uniquely Namibian country style cuisine and we offer a la carte meals when required.
According to the De Langes their whole philosophy in the operation of Lapa Lange is based on the principle of Namibian “Gemutlichkeit”. After a feast or a long relaxing walk the rock pool is the ideal place to cool off and wash away any remaining “First World” stresses.

Visitors to Lapa Lange Game Lodge can enjoy a wide range of activities that include walks in the game camp, game drives or merely relaxing next to the waterhole and watching a variety of game (30 species) come to drink.
Lapa Lange Game Lodge is nature friendly and it is our aim to bring people closer to nature and its wildlife.
Visitors to our country will be able to enjoy a real Namibian cultural learning experience and will also be able to buy handmade items produced by Nama and San people. Lapa Lange Game Lodge is the ideal stop over for tours into the Kalahari. We offer light lunches for bus tour groups and small tour groups can spend the night in the rooms or self catering units.

Main Lodge
Main Lodge
We welcome you to Lapa Lange Game Lodge, a tranquil oasis at the edge of the Kalahari.
Our manicured gardens and walkways around the lodge offer a sanctuary from the harsh Namibian elements where you can relax after an exhilarating day out in the bush.
Dining
Our kitchen uses the freshest local produce to serve up spectacular buffet style breakfast, lunch and dinner. We offer an abundance of meat options and guests are treated to a wide array of venison dishes.
The suites and chalets are well-appointed with all the creature comforts you expect on your safari vacation, including crisp bed linen and comfy beds, spotless bathrooms, air conditioning and housekeeping.
The whole lodge is centered around a waterhole, offering the perfect vantage of the animals from just about anywhere and every room. One truly feels in touch with nature.
Rinse off the Namibian heat in our crystal clear pool, the perfect place to soak up some sun with your favorite Wilbur Smith novel (and drink in hand).
